verdict.rationale: Unleash's own docs describe gradual rollouts to a small subset of users and percentage targeting such as 75% of users. They show stepping from 25% to 50%, optionally automated via release templates, and changes are made without redeploying. Consistent bucketing is not evidenced: nothing in the pack covers stickiness or the same users staying in the cohort as the percentage grows. Missing for 10: consistent bucketing/stickiness documentation, an explicit 1%-to-100% ramp walkthrough, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll a flag out progressively by percentage with consistent bucketing, ramping from 1% to 100% without redeploying

citations.quote: A gradual rollout is a controlled release strategy where a new feature is first released to a small subset of users.
to roll out a feature to 75% of users while granting access to internal users, you can add two activation strategies
They allow you to enable and disable features for certain users without having to redeploy your application.
Progress from 25% to 50% only if error rates stay below a threshold.
you can define a reusable, structured rollout process that progresses automatically while monitoring application health
